# Raster Tile Layer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Render a raster tile layer on the map.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "raster-tiles", "name": "raster-tiles", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "layer"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:minZoom`, or read elsewhere as `ch('raster-tiles/minZoom')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `data` | `string` | `"https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSImageryOnly/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}"` |  |
| `minZoom` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `maxZoom` | `float` | `24` |  |
| `tileSize` | `float` | `256` |  |
| `visible` | `toggle` | `true` |  |
| `opacity` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `parameters` | `field` | `{"depthTest":true}` |  |
| `extensions` | `field` | `[]` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

| Port | Type |
|------|------|
